title: VASS reaches priority 4 on banking, retail and public verticals with no stack research behind it
content:
VASS carries three verticals on its row — banking, retail and public — and a tool field that reads "not researched". Its priority-4 position came from a mechanical rescore of a provisional v2 tail entry using size and slot occupancy, with no v3 evidence pass behind it.

The vertical mix is the only positive signal, and it is a generic one: banking, retail and public sector describe most large Iberian integrators. Without a platform record there is nothing that separates this row from its neighbours, and nothing that tells an outreach decision whether the firm has a slot to fill or a stack to defend.

The flag's instruction is therefore the whole finding: run the OSS-portfolio screen before acting. Doing that for VASS is cheap relative to a call, and it converts a rank that currently encodes company size into an actual position on the question the pilot cares about.
